gen-audiowide-gf-numans: Tile-like and techy, Audiowide stamps out wide-spaced glyphs with no thick-thin shift. And Numans follows in a modern, clean sans-serif, its loosely tracked, swollen lowercase giving the heading some breathing room.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-square: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square has a soaring x-height and approachable, contemporary manners, with gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. But Eater, the dark display heading above it, makes a page of that sans-serif feel like a calm room with something growling upstairs.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Noto Traditional Nushu writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, and its bowls fill the line generously. Yet Flavors lands above it with whimsical swagger, towering lowercase and no pressure swells, so a long read feels friendly rather than fussy.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-newa: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display keeps its letters from ever pinching shut. Then Noto Sans Newa takes over in a modern plain sans, with open-mouthed e shapes that would carry a long read without any fuss.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-onest: Autour One draws every curve without a hairline-to-stem shift, so the heading lands bold and expressive and uniform. Onest then goes quietly on below it.
gen-audiowide-gf-parkinsans: Audiowide sets futuristic, tile-like glyphs with wide gaps and no thick-thin shift, which makes it a fine headline voice. Parkinsans does the opposite job, holding one stroke thickness and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk.
gen-eater-gf-open-sans: Thin strokes with no hairlines, sitting only slightly lighter than the stems, give Eater its dark, aggressive bite. And Open Sans answers in a plain sans that reads smoothly, its bulky lowercase keeping every curve unclogged.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-oxygen: Bold and expressive, Autour One skims along at a single stroke weight with a clear channel into each round letter. Oxygen quietly keeps up below.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham reads clean and contemporary, with wide gaps in the e and tall lowercase bodies that look bold. Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary flavor on top, and that contrast with the sans-serif is the real draw.
gen-audiowide-gf-prompt: Audiowide brings a futuristic, marker-plain look, tile-like and wide. Prompt does the quieter work as a plain sans, its oversized small letters and open apertures making the text easy to follow.
